description:
Create a reusable Display Filter Macro in Wireshark to analyze TCP quality issues. 

1. Open Wireshark.
2. Go to Analyze > Display Filter Macros.
3. Create a NEW macro with these exact details:
   - Name: `tcp_bad_quality`
   - Text: `tcp.analysis.retransmission || tcp.analysis.fast_retransmission || tcp.analysis.spurious_retransmission`
4. Open the capture file `~/Documents/captures/200722_tcp_anon.pcapng`.
5. Apply your new macro as a display filter using the syntax `${tcp_bad_quality}`.
6. Count the number of packets displayed.
7. Save the count (just the integer number) to a text file at `~/Documents/packet_count.txt`.
